title: Corgi, which uses AI to provide insurance for startups, raised a $106M Series B1 at a $2.6B valuation, up from $1.3B on May 6, for a total funding of $378M (Dominic-Madori Davis/TechCrunch)
summary: Dominic-Madori Davis / TechCrunch: Corgi, which uses AI to provide insurance for startups, raised a $106M Series B1 at a $2.6B valuation, up from $1.3B on May 6, for a total funding of $378M — Insurance tech Corgi on Thursday announced a $106 million Series B1 raise, valuing the company at $2.6 billion …
